start: Owner; the gym is on Pro and online; no workout offer is running

steps.action: Open 'Messages & offers' and tap the tab 'Workout offer'
user_sees: 'Start a workout offer' with boxes 'Workouts', 'Within (days of joining)', 'Reward (extra days)', 'Members can join until'
'Check-ins that count': 'Desk and QR poster' or 'Desk only'
'How the days are given': 'I give them (the desk gives with one tap)' or 'Give the days by themselves when a member qualifies'
'What members see' with a preview headed 'OFFER'
must_not: A start form while an offer is already running

steps.action: Fill the numbers and tap 'Start offer'
user_sees: 'Starting…', then the note 'Offer started. Members see it in the MettleUp app now.'
The offer's card in place of the form, with 'Nobody has joined yet. Members join from the Gym tab in the MettleUp app.'
must_not: Two offers from a double tap
A number outside the allowed range accepted

steps.action: Days later, a member shows as ready for the reward: tap 'Give <n> days'
user_sees: 'Giving…', then '<n> days added for <name>. New last day: <date>.'
A green line on the member's row saying the reward was given, and a 'Take back' button
must_not: The days added twice
The new last day worked out from the wrong membership

start: An offer is running in the 'I give them' way (the other way of giving)

steps.action: On the offer card pick 'By themselves'
user_sees: The note 'The days are now given by themselves.'
must_not: Members who were already ready left waiting for ever

steps.action: Pick 'I give them' again
user_sees: The note 'The desk now gives the days with one tap.'
must_not: Days already given taken back

start: Owner of a gym on Starter, or a gym whose records are not online

steps.action: On Starter, tap the tab 'Workout offer'
user_sees: A card 'Part of the Pro pack'
'Giving extra membership days to members who work out often comes with the Pro pack.'
'Your gym is on Starter. To move to Pro, open Help and feedback in the menu and write: Move us to Pro.'
must_not: The start form
An offer that was running before still giving days with no way to see it

steps.action: On a gym that is not online, open the tab
user_sees: 'Workout offers need your gym online' with a line pointing to Settings → Staff & sign-in
must_not: An error

steps.action: On Pro and online, type 0 in 'Workouts'
user_sees: The hint with the allowed range; 'Start offer' greyed
must_not: An offer nobody can ever finish

start: An offer is running; one member was given the reward

steps.action: Tap 'Take back' on that member
user_sees: A browser question 'Take back the <n> reward days from <name>? Their plan's last day goes back.'
must_not: The days removed with no question

steps.action: Agree
user_sees: 'Reward taken back. Last day: <date>.'; the row says who took it back
must_not: The member's last day unchanged
More days removed than were given

steps.action: Tap 'Give <n> days' for a member another device already rewarded
user_sees: '<name> already has the reward.' with the last day
must_not: A second set of days

steps.action: Tap 'Stop offer' and agree to 'Stop this offer? Nobody new can join. Members already in keep their days to finish.'
user_sees: 'Offer stopped. Members already in can still finish.'; the start form is back above the stopped offer
must_not: Members already in losing their progress
The offer still shown as open in the member app

start: An offer with members in it; one of them was later removed from the member list

steps.action: Read the offer card
user_sees: Each member by name with how far they are and a status pill
'A member (removed)' for the one no longer in the list
must_not: What a member did in a workout: exercises, weights, sets, body weight or photos
The removed member's name

start: Front desk signed in; the owner started an offer in the 'I give them' way; a member has reached the target

steps.action: Open the menu row 'Workout offer' ('Give members the rewards they earned')
user_sees: Title 'Workout offer' with 'Rewards for members who train'
Tabs 'Workout offer' and 'Reminders' only
The offer card with the member marked ready
must_not: A tab 'Messages'
The start form
'Stop offer' or the choice of how days are given

steps.action: Tap 'Give <n> days' on the member
user_sees: 'Giving…', then '<n> days added for <name>. New last day: <date>.'
must_not: The days given twice
A 'Take back' button for the desk

start: Front desk; opens the address of the owner's page (/messages), for example from a bookmark

steps.action: Open /messages
user_sees: The 'Workout offer' section, not the message form
must_not: The owner's message form or the list of sent messages

start: Front desk; no offer is running, or the gym is on Starter

steps.action: Open 'Workout offer' with no offer running
user_sees: 'No workout offer running' and 'The owner starts one in Messages & offers.'
must_not: A start form the desk cannot use

steps.action: Open it on a Starter gym
user_sees: 'Part of the Pro pack' and the line telling how to move to Pro
must_not: A menu row that leads to a dead end with no words

steps.action: Look at a member whose reward was already given
user_sees: The green given line; no button
must_not: 'Take back' for the desk

start: Front desk; the desk gave a reward and the owner later took it back

steps.action: Open 'Workout offer' again
user_sees: The member's row with 'Taken back by <owner's name>.'
must_not: The row still green as given

steps.action: Look for a way to give it again
user_sees: Whether the desk may give again is the server's rule (not read): the button shows only when allowed
must_not: The desk giving back days the owner removed without the owner knowing

start: Front desk on the offer page

steps.action: Read the list
user_sees: Members' names, progress and status
must_not: Workout details of a member
The owner's messages to members
